name: Gmail
description: Delegated Gmail access for bounded inbox search, reading, and draft creation.

skills.label: Public OAuth preview: read, search, and create drafts without exposing Google passwords or OAuth tokens to agents.

validation.label: Connection status
validation.helperText: Delegated OAuth is available when the operator configures the Google client ID, secret, callback URI, and encryption master key. Passwords and app passwords are not accepted.
